translation.text: In the days of their judgment[a] they will bless him for his mercy, according to what he apportioned to them.[b]

footnotes.text: Some witnesses prefix “and” to the opening days phrase; the selected main printed text begins with “in.”
The selected text says “as he apportioned to them” without separately naming the object. This rendering does not supply an inheritance or another unstated object.
